excluded.description: Tickers with NO buying mechanism at all (e.g. a delisting/wind-down). Distinct from `whole_share` below.

whole_share.description: Tickers not tradable for fractional/notional buys, evaluated by the same graded ladder as `active` but bought via the whole-share accumulation path (dca_whole_share_accumulator.py, docs/whole_share_accumulation.md) instead of a normal dollar-amount order. Distinct from -- never overlapping with -- `active` and `excluded`. Canonical uppercase, same pattern as `active`: a lowercase entry would still normalize correctly in this repo's own comparisons, but the wired Robinhood tradability lookup compares against the broker's own (uppercase) response symbol case-insensitively as a defense, not a guarantee for every future consumer.

pinned.description: Hand-held names kept in `active` outside the daily ranking (ETFs, funds and filers with no us-gaap facts, which cannot be scored). A subset of `active`, never overlapping `excluded`. The program never adds, ranks or drops them (docs/fundamentals_feed_scope.md).

data_source_notes.description: Per-ticker free-text notes about data-source availability/resolution quirks (e.g. a symbol resolved on Robinhood but unresolved/NOT_FOUND on the finance connector). Keys are tickers from `active`; values must be non-empty, non-placeholder text.

no_buy.description: Dated buy pauses (wash-sale windows after a tax-loss sale; docs/adr-no-buy-window.md). Keys are tickers from `active`, which stay tracked; each is blocked from buying while blocked_on <= today <= until (both inclusive, US Eastern) unless released_on is set and reached. A release (scripts/no_buy_window.py) sets released_on and never deletes the entry. Distinct from the permanent `excluded` list. dca_config.no_buy_blocked_tickers enforces the stricter rules (symbol in `active`, not in `excluded`, until >= blocked_on, released_on >= blocked_on).
